title: Locally sourced masonry wall study

evidenceNeeded: Local unit and mortar test evidence
maintenance: Sealant and coating access where specified

title: Engineered earth wall study
summary: Study an earthen enclosure only where local soil, craft, rainfall, drainage and structural conditions support it.

title: Ventilated rainscreen study
summary: Separate weather protection from the backing wall and test a replaceable outer layer against the project climate.

title: Insulated lightweight roof study
summary: Explore a drained lightweight roof over larger clear spans, coordinated with acoustics, heat gain and rain noise.
maintenance: Safe access to replace seals and panels

title: Concrete roof and thermal layer study
summary: Study a concrete roof where structure, waterproofing, heat control, drainage and future repair access are resolved together.

title: Replaceable prayer-carpet module
summary: Coordinate prayer rows, seams, columns, accessible positions and replaceable zones before selecting a product.

title: Hard floor with removable prayer finish
summary: Study a durable base floor with a removable worship finish where flexibility, cleaning or flood recovery matters.

title: Performance-led geometric screen
summary: Develop screen geometry from solar, privacy, ventilation, cleaning and cultural-review criteria rather than appearance alone.
